description: Search, browse, or fetch full product and review data from the live catalog that carries Eldorado's former product line (eldorado.ru's own storefront closed and redirects to the M.Video marketplace — see the README for the research trail).

brands.description: Only return products from these brands. Accepts the brand name as the site spells it (Samsung, LG, TCL). Multiple values are combined as 'any of these'; the live brand facet is resolved for each query or category.
brands.title: Brands (mode=search / byCategory)

category.description: Top-level category to browse. Leave empty and use `categoryUrls` for any sub-category or a custom taxonomy branch.
enumTitles: Запчасти и аксессуары для садовой техники
Коды для фильмов, музыки и книг
category.title: Category (mode=byCategory)

categoryUrls.description: Any mvideo.ru category URL or numeric category ID, e.g. https://www.mvideo.ru/televizory-i-cifrovoe-tv-1/televizory-65. Use this for sub-categories that are not in the Category dropdown; values are browsed in addition to it.
categoryUrls.title: Custom category URLs or IDs (mode=byCategory)

city.description: Russian city name or mvideo.ru city ID (for example Москва, Санкт-Петербург, CityCZ_975). The city controls current prices, pickup stores and delivery dates.
city.title: City

condition.description: Filter by item condition through the site's live condition facet. The source exposes new, refurbished, markdown and showcase values (used is not a facet value). If the facet is unavailable for the chosen query or category, the run reports it instead of returning unfiltered products.
condition.title: Condition

failOnEmpty.description: Mark the run as failed when zero rows are emitted, for example when the site is blocked or a query genuinely matches nothing.
failOnEmpty.title: Fail when nothing is found

fetchDetails.description: Fetch each product's detail record (description, specifications, seller, documents, variants, exact price) instead of listing fields only. Applies to search and category browsing; productDetails always fetches details. Turn off for fast, cheap listing-level runs.
fetchDetails.title: Fetch full product details

fromAbroad.description: Only return parallel-import listings, resolved through the site's live 'Товары из-за рубежа' facet.
fromAbroad.title: Parallel import only

inStockOnly.description: Only emit products that are currently available (not sold out).
inStockOnly.title: In stock only

includeOtherOffers.description: Fetch the marketplace offer block and attach otherOffers[] with prices, seller names and seller ratings when available.
includeOtherOffers.title: Include other seller offers (productDetails)

includeStoreStock.description: Fetch per-store pickup availability for the chosen city and attach a stores[] list.
includeStoreStock.title: Include pickup store stock (productDetails)

maxItems.description: Hard cap on product rows (or review rows in mode=reviews). Invalid-input error rows are additional and do not count toward this cap. Use 0 for all, capped at 10,000. For full search coverage set a high cap and turn off Fetch full product details.
maxItems.title: Max items

maxPrice.description: Drop products more expensive than this sale price, in Russian rubles. Applied in the catalog itself, so pagination stays efficient.
maxPrice.title: Max price (RUB)

maxReviews.description: Reviews to fetch per product in productDetails (attached as reviews[]) and reviews mode (one row per review), paginated 20 at a time. Set to 0 to skip review fetching entirely.
maxReviews.title: Customer reviews per product

minDiscount.description: Drop products with a smaller discount than this (0-99 percent). Products without a discount are excluded when this filter is set.
minDiscount.title: Min discount (%)

minPrice.description: Drop products cheaper than this sale price, in Russian rubles. Applied in the catalog itself, so pagination stays efficient.
minPrice.title: Min price (RUB)

minRating.description: Drop products with a customer rating below this. Products with no rating are excluded when this filter is set.
minRating.title: Min rating (0-5)

mode.description: What to fetch. Choose keyword search, a category browse, full details for exact products, a flat review export, or paste mvideo.ru links.
enumTitles: Customer reviews as one row each
Paste mvideo.ru product, search or category links
mode.title: Mode

productUrls.description: mvideo.ru product URLs or bare numeric product IDs. Old eldorado.ru/cat/detail/... links no longer resolve to a catalog page — use the current URL or numeric ID instead.
productUrls.title: Product URLs or IDs (mode=productDetails / reviews)

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. The actor connects directly first and only escalates to Apify Proxy or a residential session if mvideo.ru refuses the direct connection. Leave the default unless you need a specific proxy setup.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

searchQueries.description: One or more product search phrases, e.g. телевизор, ноутбук, холодильник. Each phrase is searched and the results are merged without duplicates. If the field is empty, the actor uses `телевизор`.
searchQueries.title: Search queries (mode=search)

sortOrder.description: Result ordering. The catalog supports popularity and sale-price ordering; other orderings are not offered by the source.
sortOrder.title: Sort order (mode=search / byCategory)

storeLimit.description: Cap on stores[] entries per product when pickup store stock is included.
storeLimit.title: Max stores per product

urls.description: Paste mvideo.ru product links, search result links (…/product-list-page?q=…) or category links. Products are fetched in full; search and category links are walked page by page. Unsupported links are reported as error rows.
urls.title: Links to open (mode=byUrl)
